title: Nandhavana Theru
desc: Seenu, an orphan and a thief, forms a bond with a wrongly convicted man in the prison and decides to unite him with his niece. Little does he know his life is going to change forever.

title: Ponmanam
desc: An unemployed Anandhan's family has no expectations from him. However, when his parents commit suicide after his sister elopes, he is determined to find her.

title: Good Luck
desc: Surya, a carefree young man, lives in Malaysia with his brother and sister-in-law. He falls in love with Priya, a dancer, but problems arise when she learns that he has a daughter.

title: Osthe
desc: Velan dislikes his father and his half-brother Balan. As a police officer, he locks horns with a local politician who uses the hostility between the brothers as an advantage.

title: Ellaisamy
desc: A righteous village chieftain finds himself in a situation where a woman is assaulted. Will he resort to justice, or will he take matters into his own hands?
